create.title: Exact cone rational spectrum, reconstruction, and local-slope self-return obstruction
create.statement_tex: For C(m)=sum_(hr=m, r odd, r>4h)chi_4(r) and every reduced a/q, sum_(m<=M)C(m)e(am/q)=1_(4|q)i*pi*chi_4(a)M/(2q)+O((sqrt(M)+q)log(2q)), uniformly in q. The fixed-height DFT is g_h(m)=(-i/(2h))sum_(b mod 4h, b odd)chi_4(b)e(bm/(4h)); every finite reduced-mode projection leaves nonzero means at all omitted denominators. Limiting coefficient l1 mass is asymptotic to Q and squared mass to log Q. The exact hard cutoff has the Möbius form (pi/4)sum_(ell|m)chi_4(m/ell)sum_(k<=Q/(4ell), k odd)mu(k)chi_4(k)/k, while complete-numerator denominator-Abel damping converges pointwise to sigma_chi4(m)=r_2(m)/4, not C(m), and leaves C unchanged when the odd part has chi_4=-1. Freezing the moving height boundary leaves unsigned weighted incidence asymptotic to M^(1/4). Local slope cells have length M^(3/4)/R and require residual short-interval norm X^epsilon sqrt(M)/R, a factor R beyond the rational prefix error; phase-value nonresonance gives no derivative-arc exclusion. The smooth stationary principal symbol has reciprocal phase Nh/z, exact N^(-1/4) amplitude, owner-sized denominator capacity, and a second principal saddle returning the original square-root phase and character. Branchwise remainders, hard endpoints, and Fresnel transitions are not proved. These are scoped mechanism obstructions, not a signed lower bound or target failure.
